rejection_summary: Primeval (2007-2011, tt0808096): a scientist-led team repeatedly investigates time anomalies and the prehistoric/future organisms crossing through them, with meaningful anomaly research and escalating temporal implications, but the complete-series structure devotes too much runtime to recurring creature-incursion containment/action and does not provide enough consistently dominant scientific rule discovery across the full run to clear the 82 baseline threshold.

The Stone Tape (1972, tt0069316): a research team actively tests an apparent haunting as a possible physical recording phenomenon in ancient stone, but the investigation ultimately escalates into supernatural horror with an unresolved/malevolent force rather than enough concrete discoverable-system payoff to clear 82.

Trinity (2003, tt0264108): the Arctic research-station/genetic-program premise strongly matches biology, experiments and secret research, but the film is primarily a slow psychological confrontation around an already-established breeding program rather than sustained investigation of an unknown phenomenon or progressively discovered rule system, so it remains below 82.
